Local browser OCR bundles:

- Tesseract.js 6.0.1: Apache-2.0. See LICENSE.md.
- Tesseract.js core 6.1.2: Apache-2.0. See core/LICENSE.
- English and Indonesian best_int traineddata from @tesseract.js-data/eng
  and @tesseract.js-data/ind 1.0.0: source package license MIT; traineddata
  originates from the Tesseract tessdata project. See
  https://github.com/naptha/tessdata and
  https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast.
- Browser bundle third-party notices: see tesseract.min.js.LICENSE.txt and
  worker.min.js.LICENSE.txt.

OCR is executed in the user's browser. The worker and models are served as
static application assets; selected document contents are not uploaded.
